# Z0

> Z0 is a native macOS companion that tunes official Technic + Tekkit 2 for this Mac, then opens Technic so you press Play. It never launches Minecraft.

- Download: /downloads/Z0-0.1.0-macos-arm64.zip
- Privacy: /privacy
- Product: independent companion, not Minecraft / Tekkit / Technic
- Platform: macOS 14+, Apple Silicon
- Certified pack: Tekkit 2 1.2.6, Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge 14.23.5.2860
